# E12: Non-Renewable Resources

**Display ID:** E12  
**Pillar:** Environmental Criteria  
**Points:** 1  
**Mandatory for Certification:** No  
**Category:** Circular Design and Waste Reduction  
**Applicability:** Project  
**Project types:** Print, Hybrid, Book, Postcard, Packaging, Signage, Exhibit  
**Related SDGs:** SDG 9, SDG 12, SDG 14, SDG 15

## Summary
Reduces non-renewable natural resources and materials.

## Criteria
The project reduces or eliminates the use of scarce, non-renewable natural resources and raw materials.

## Why it matters
Strategies reduce the use of non-renewable natural resources.

## Extended guidance
#### What are non-renewable resources?

A non-renewable resource (also called a finite resource) is a natural resource that cannot be readily replaced by natural means at a pace quick enough to keep up with consumption. Source: [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Non-renewable_resource). Non-renewable resources can also include:

* rare earth elements (REEs)
* platinum-group metals (PGMs)
* radioisotopes (uranium and thorium)
* precious metals (gold, silver, and tantalum)
